text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Special exchange...
Now that head is clear, 
terms are quite favorable...

"Special Exchange Program." 
Reminded Furioso of potential upsides.

Remain on Funabashi roster while
attending 
Central Tracen and using facilities freely.
Rare offer.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Aware of gap between Central and us. 
However...

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
If facilities match ours,
no point attending. 
Let's evaluate calmly on site.

text_block_list.name: Hayakawa Tazuna
text_block_list.text:
Furioso-san, Trainer-san, good afternoon. 
I am Hayakawa Tazuna,
secretary to Academy Chairman.

text_block_list.name: Hayakawa Tazuna
text_block_list.text:
Now then,
allow me to guide you around campus.

Guided by Tazuna-san, 
toured Central Tracen Academy.

text_block_list.name: Hayakawa Tazuna
text_block_list.text:
This is cafeteria.
For Tracen Academy students, 
lunch is complimentary and
all-you-can-eat.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
All-you-can-eat...? Completely free...? 
Not just standard 150-yen lunch
discount...?

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Hold on, Trainer. 
Don't let Central sway you.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Must not be seduced by food. 
We are here strictly to observe.

text_block_list.name: Hayakawa Tazuna
text_block_list.text:
This is training gym. 
All equipment is calibrated specifically
for Uma Musume.

text_block_list.name: Hayakawa Tazuna
text_block_list.text:
Here is pool. Primarily used by racers 
rehabilitating leg injuries or building
stamina.

text_block_list.name: Hayakawa Tazuna
text_block_list.text:
These are training tracks. Turf, dirt,
and woodchip 
surfaces available. And over there...

text_block_list.name: Oguri & Inari
text_block_list.text:
Haaaaaaah! 
Deryaaaa—!

text_block_list.name: Hayakawa Tazuna
text_block_list.text:
Students freely compete to sharpen
skills. 
Oguri Cap-san and Inari One-san 
also transferred in from local circuits.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Incredible... 
Tracks,
equipment...
whole scale is entirely different...
choice_data_list: Yeah, the gap is so huge……
Yeah, the gap is so huge……

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Gap is massive... 
Trainer, look closely. At this dirt.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Far more intimidating than facility
size— 
is sand grain quality.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Even distribution across entire surface. 
Meticulously maintained to minimize strain
on legs...

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
How many staff needed for this level of
upkeep? 
Their technical skill... formidable.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Frustrating,
but... gap with Funabashi is huge... 
Everything operates on another level...

Goal was to stay based at Funabashi 
while entering Central races whenever
possible.

Yet faced with stark divide between
Funabashi 
and Central...
correct choice was painfully clear.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, must reconsider stance. 
Regarding "Special Exchange Program."

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Together, we invade enemy territory 
and conquer from within. That is the plan.

text_block_list.name: Hayakawa Tazuna
text_block_list.text:
Glad you are interested. 
Um... however,
one important detail to note.

text_block_list.name: Hayakawa Tazuna
text_block_list.text:
Furioso-san may transfer under exchange
rules... 
Trainer-san, were you aware you cannot?

text_block_list.name: Hayakawa Tazuna
text_block_list.text:
Correct. No exemptions apply. 
Local and Central trainer licenses are
separate credentials.

text_block_list.name: Hayakawa Tazuna
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-san must sit for and pass 
Central "Trainer License Examination."

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Central License Exam...? Sounds rigorous, 
but... with Trainer's track record,
should be no issue.

Confidence is high.
Venue changes nothing; 
trainer remains trainer.
Methods for drawing out 
Uma Musume potential stay identical.
In that case—

Perform as usual, 
and results will follow.
Day exam results posted—

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: What...?

Frantically scanned list again. 
Yet—

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: Impossible...

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: Not there... your name.
